{{Short description|French chemist}}
'''Camille Georges Wermuth''' (died September 2015)<ref>{{cite journal|title=In Memoriam: Camille Georges Wermuth|date=1 January 2016|journal=[[Chemistry International]]|volume=38|issue=1|doi=10.1515/ci-2016-0116|doi-access=free}}</ref> was a chemist in the Laboratoire de Pharmacochimie Moleculaire at the [[Universite Louis Pasteur]] in [[Illkirch]], France. He is particularly known for his editing of ''The Practice of Medicinal Chemistry'' (1996) which has been issued in four editions.

==Selected publications==
*''The Practice of Medicinal Chemistry''. 1996.<ref>{{cite book|url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/book/9780123741943|title=The Practice of Medicinal Chemistry |edition=Third|editor=Camille Georges Wermuth|isbn=978-0-12-374194-3|year=2008 }}</ref>
